title: Chuloo/mural
why_read: A native iOS language-learning conversation app is a consumer product rather than something offering deep engineering insight for a technical digest.
analysis: Mural is described as a native iPhone app for learning languages through conversation, positioned as an app users eventually delete once they've learned enough. This is primarily a product/UX story rather than a technically deep engineering topic, though the native Kotlin Multiplatform approach for an iOS app is mildly interesting. It's more relevant to consumer app builders than to a general software engineering audience.
